clues.text: When Jesus crossed back over the sea by boat, this synagogue leader came and fell at His feet.
This father begged Jesus to place His hands on his little daughter so she would be healed and live.
His only daughter, about twelve years old, was dying when he begged Jesus to come to his house.
As Jesus walked with this father toward his house, a woman bleeding for twelve years touched His cloak.
Messengers from his house told this synagogue leader his daughter was dead and not to bother the Teacher anymore.
Overhearing that the man's daughter had died, Jesus told this synagogue leader, "Do not be afraid; just believe."
Mourners at this synagogue leader's house laughed when Jesus said his daughter was not dead but asleep.
